title: Per-route & model cost-latency matrix tally service
creator: Asha Patel
description: Build a resilient service that computes a per-route / per-model / per-customer matrix of cost and latency contributions suitable for the Console dashboards and downstream billing reconciliation. This service should: (1) consume streaming usage events and compacted token-level traces, (2) apply attribution heuristics for batched requests and KV cache hits, (3) produce daily and hourly rollups with configurable retention, and (4) expose a reconciliation endpoint for ledger ingestion. Goal is to replace the brittle ad-hoc SQL jobs with a unified, testable computation engine that provides stable unit economics for product and finance teams.
acceptance_criteria: Hourly rollups for cost and p50/p95 latency in S3/Parquet per tenant and route
Streaming and nightly batch paths produce reconciliable outputs within 0.5% of benchmark ledger for synthetic workloads
Support attribution of tokens to model variant when fallbacks occur (primary->fallback) and surface fallback counts
API endpoint for on-demand per-tenant slices and reconciliation exports, auth'ed by service account
Backfill of last 30 days using batch pipeline without data gaps
implementation_notes: Two-path architecture: low-latency streaming aggregator (Kafka->Flink) and batch verifier (Spark nightly)
Use Count-Min sketches for coarse-grained token counting to bound memory in streaming windows; materialize exact counts during nightly run for accuracy-sensitive slices
Attribution model: windowed prefix attribution for cached prefixes, edge-case heuristics for concurrent KV cache modifications
Emit provenance metadata (source=stream|batch, model_version, kernel_profile, batch_id) for every output row
Expose a lightweight /reconcile endpoint that accepts ledger slices and returns mismatch report and suggested corrections
progress_updates: 2026-03-02: Kickoff; aligned on two-path architecture with infra and data-platform leads
2026-03-04: Spike completed for Count-Min parameters; memory/accuracy trade-off doc attached to design page
2026-03-06: Implemented streaming prototype in Flink that consumes token_events topic and outputs hourly windows to staging bucket
2026-03-08: Discovered skew on large enterprise tenants due to per-route fanout; introducing route sharding strategy
2026-03-10: Batch verifier job skeleton in Spark parquet->Delta, able to reprocess last 7 days locally
review_feedback: PM (Lena Choi): ensure reconciler includes model fallback counts and labels for canary rollouts
Security (Ravi Singh): enforce service-account-only access to reconciliation endpoint and log all exports
Data-platform (Elena Gomez): prefer Delta over raw Parquet for incremental upserts; we should preserve idempotency metadata
Finance reviewer: add explicit cost attribution for GPU-second vs token compute to facilitate chargebacks
notes_on_accuracy: Streaming path provides approximate counts with tunable epsilon. Expect up to 1-2% error for extremely high-cardinality tenants; nightly batch reconciler produces exact counts and corrective deltas. We will run A/B comparison against current ledger for two weeks before flipping consumers to new outputs.
